trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy on this list — all 54 of them — and this one unlocks on its own. It is the last trophy you will earn, so treat the roadmap as the plan.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is unmissable story progress, so just keep playing.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full. Story progress only — nothing here can be missed except the single missable trophy flagged in the roadmap, so do the Lucia balcony meditation before the chapter moves on.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Another story trophy that comes from playing the campaign through to the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep following the story missions until the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story progress, unlocked as the campaign advances.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. The campaign's closing trophy, and one of only two Golds in the game.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Follow the story until this mission appears, then finish it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story heist — play the mission through to the getaway.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story progress; it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport — see it through to the end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the operation and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. That means the story, all stranger strands, activities, collectibles and challenges — use the checklist to sweep what is left, then this Gold drops.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the running total. Chain them during normal driving and the count climbs without grinding.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: a short taste of every pastime the game offers, from shooting ranges to races. One go at each is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's scoring, then repeat the ones you miss until every challenge shows gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's line, then clear the locations one by one.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but each win must be in a race you have not won before — vary the events.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Out-fish him head to head; watch the challenge rules and land the better catch.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Pick any arcade cabinet, play it through to its end, and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's strand until his last mission appears, then finish it.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. See Billy's strand through to its final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Keep an eye out for stranger markers as you explore, and finish eight full strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — all 18 spots. Start in Chapter 1: the Lucia balcony meditation is the one moment that cannot be revisited, so do it before the chapter moves on, then sweep the remaining spots.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's lead to the animal, take the shot cleanly, and bring it down.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Gather cards around Leonida and finish any three full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK feature at a hundred different spots — spread it across your travels and the count builds up.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small goals scattered through activities and the world; tick them off as you play and 50 comes naturally.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat dies.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan the route first, hit three shops in a row, and keep the wanted level alive between them — losing it resets the run.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive, steal and find new rides — each new model you get behind the wheel of counts.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies first, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Find a way out of the airport that is not on any schedule — improvise a runway exit.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get into trouble with Rhino tanks and come out on top — the description itself is the hint.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm, in and out unseen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five separate bank vaults and get clear after each one. Grade note: the PSN-mirroring trackers list this as Silver; one guide lists it as Bronze — this guide follows Silver.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck, crack it open, and get away clean.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. Drive, fly and walk the map until every area has been visited.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang — nine hits in total, each against a different gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight out through the showroom front.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a round of bowling at the alley and finish it.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no confirmed unlock method is known at launch, so this guide does not guess. The description hints at a partnership with mass appeal; check back once the community confirms it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no confirmed unlock method is known at launch. PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 for this trophy, but what the count measures is not confirmed, so this guide does not guess.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no confirmed unlock method is known at launch. The description suggests succeeding on a second try, but that is not confirmed, so this guide does not guess.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no confirmed unlock method is known at launch. The description suggests witnessing something strange, but that is not confirmed, so this guide does not guess.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Line up a pass in a vehicle, swing a melee weapon as you go by, and knock someone down.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Feed marked bills through your laundering contacts until $250,000 is clean.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Shop spending adds up across every store — clothes, food, gear — until the total passes $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — all 8 of them. Buy every garage on the market and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Add ten different vehicles you own to the app.
